# generated by tools/air_trade.py (spec 64): air imports by transport airship
TU_air_trade_category = {
	TU_air_import_oil = {
		icon = GFX_decision_generic_air
		allowed = { always = yes }

		target_trigger = {
			FROM = {
				NOT = { tag = ROOT }
				exists = yes
				OR = { tag = KZD tag = RIM tag = URS }
			}
		}

		visible = {
			has_tech = early_transport_plane
		}

		available = {
			has_equipment = { transport_plane_equipment > 9 }
			NOT = { has_war_with = FROM }
			FROM = { NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT } }
		}

		cost = 25
		fire_only_once = no
		days_remove = 180

		modifier = {
			civilian_factory_use = 1
		}

		complete_effect = {
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = transport_plane_equipment amount = -10 }
			capital_scope = {
				add_resource = { type = oil amount = 8 }
				add_to_variable = { TU_air_oil = 8 }
			}
			FROM = { add_political_power = 15 }
		}

		remove_effect = {
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = transport_plane_equipment amount = 8 }
			random_owned_state = {
				limit = { check_variable = { TU_air_oil > 7 } }
				add_resource = { type = oil amount = -8 }
				add_to_variable = { TU_air_oil = -8 }
			}
		}

		ai_will_do = {
			base = 1
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				has_equipment = { transport_plane_equipment < 30 }
			}
		}
	}
